identitySignals: OUSD Legistar record names the vendor 'Adventure Time Extended Day Care/Tuller Corporation', Berkeley, CA, running a before- and after-school child care and enrichment program at Chabot, Crocker Highlands, Glenview, Hillcrest, Kaiser, Montclair and Thornhill (matches OUSD's after-school program contracts)
adventure-time.com describes before and after school care and enrichment for children at Bay Area elementary schools, with a Berkeley, CA mailing address (matches the agenda location)
The 'Adventure Time Extended Day Care' trademark was owned by Tuller Corporation (Piedmont, CA) per Trademarkia, linking the brand to the Tuller Corporation named in the agenda

Caution: a separate nonprofit, Adventure Time Extended Day Care Corporation (EIN 88-1783490, Berkeley, tax exempt since May 2022), appears to be the later operator; it is unclear which legal entity OUSD contracted with in 2019-2022
research.notes: Two related entities exist: Tuller Corporation (company, Piedmont CA, former trademark owner, named in OUSD agenda) and Adventure Time Extended Day Care Corporation (nonprofit public benefit corporation, filed March 2022, EIN 88-1783490). OUSD's 2019-2022 agreements name Tuller Corporation; the website's operator entity is not stated. Legal name, orgType and registry IDs deliberately left null. Berkeley Parents Network reports OUSD ended the program at 8 schools in 2022. Not publishable without a reviewer deciding which entity.

profile.summary: Adventure Time Extended Day Care provides before and after school child care and enrichment programs for children in transitional kindergarten through 6th grade at elementary school campuses in the Bay Area. Activities include language arts, music, art, drama, sports, games, cooking and homework help.
